source_note: Kummer判别：对多种比值判别变形的统一
english_source_note: Kummer's Test: A Unified View of Ratio-Type Tests
callout_id: Kummer判别:对多种比值判别变形的统一#4
statement_en:
For a positive-term series $\sum_n a_n$, if
$$\frac{a_n}{a_{n+1}}=1+\frac{1}{n}+O\left(\frac{1}{n^r}\right), \quad r>1,$$ then the series diverges.
callout_body: 对于正项级数$\sum_n a_n$，如果$$\frac{a_n}{a_{n+1}}=1+\frac{1}{n}+O\left(\frac{1}{n^r}\right),r>1$$那么级数发散。
